before.name: Henry Shepard
before.description: Henry Shepard was a Black Communist candidate for lieutenant-governor of New York jailed five days in 1932 for leading a relief delegation of Harlem's unemployed.

source_image: Daily Worker September 30, 1932 page 3, lower-left candidate portrait
credit: Photographer unknown. Daily Worker, September 30, 1932, page 3; Library of Congress scan via Marxists Internet Archive.

identity_verification: Contemporaneous montage caption explicitly names lower-left Henry Shepard, Communist candidate for Lieutenant Governor of New York. Matches profile; Iowa State University July 8, 1932 Bystander record corroborates Harlem relief-protest arrest.
